note: Lewis County (NY) publishes zoning only as PDF maps for its towns and villages (Denmark, Harrisburg, Lewis, Lowville, Martinsburg, Montague, Osceola, Pinckney, Turin, Watson, West Turin, Greig). The county GIS Cloud zoning viewer reports 'The app has been disabled by the owner'. The county's Beacon (Schneider) GIS viewer is a web app with no public zoning service found. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches for Lewis County zoning returned only solar, parcel and unrelated layers. No queryable zoning district polygon service was found for the county or its villages.
